articles.summary: The five messages every Airbnb stay needs, written to be copied and adapted: a pre-booking message that screens without scaring people off, a welcome that sets expectations, check-in instructions guests actually read, a checkout message that protects your turnover, and a review request that doesn't beg. Plus when to send each one and which to automate.
articles.title: Airbnb message templates for hosts: pre-booking, welcome, check-in, checkout and review request

articles.summary: Airbnb removes reviews for exactly five reasons, and the dispute form gives you one reason and 2,500 characters to make the case. Here's what qualifies, what doesn't, how to build the case from the guest conversation you already have, and the structure that fits the form.
articles.title: How to remove an Airbnb review (and how to tell if yours qualifies)
